name: Meritorious Service Award (full-size medal body)
size_basis: Body width 1.375 in = the standard ribbon width for this size (1 3/8 in full, 5/8 in miniature; DoDM 1348.33 as relayed by the coordination chat, not verified locally); proportions from the McChord rasters (disc = ribbon width); CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions. Height is the constructed body plus suspension ring.

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: Designed and measured from the Vanguard miniature photograph meritorious-service.jpeg (reference only): each element is a modelled object in inches, the same model as the miniature drawn at 2.2x, upright (design/b-meritorious-service-award.js). Previously constructed from the McChord rasters.

fit.metric: same model as the miniature body, which is gated against the photograph (silhouette IoU, landmarks within 0.02 in, edge recall, ink coverage)
fit.note: Shape-built art at 2.2x; ring and bail are cut open at the box top (the drape passes through).

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width); every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = body centre, +y down, upright)

measured.hang_angle_note: angle (clockwise, degrees) at which the photographed medal hangs, from the bail axis; measured, removed: the shipped body is upright and ribbon_attach is the top centre of the ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring)

frame_shift.reason: the box bottom is 0.3125 in below the origin in make-b.js; the hexagon lower vertex is 0.352 in below the centre of the flats

measured.hexagon_flats_frame: top vertex (0.005,-0.343), upper corners (0.3125,-0.186) and (-0.3127,-0.179), lower corners (0.3125,0.1795) and (-0.3127,0.1835), bottom vertex (0,0.352); width across the flats 0.625 in, height 0.695 in; rim lip 0.003 in, bevel bands 0.005 to 0.020/0.026/0.030 in inside the outline (unequal per edge)
measured.emblem_flats_frame: circle centre (0.0054,-0.172), centre-line radius 0.0755, width 0.0085; equilateral triangle apex (0.0033,-0.2345), base at v -0.1295; hub (0.0042,-0.172); 8 bars at pitch 0.0147
measured.band_flats_frame: outer -0.2924..0.2941 x -0.0411..0.0711, bar width 0.01; capitals cap height 0.058 in, stroke 0.0085 in, centred at v 0.0165
